message.content: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "AbstractUnArchiver", "method": "extractFile", "explanation": "The attacker-controlled archive entry name reaches new FileOutputStream(f) after FileUtils.resolveFile(dir, entryName). The only containment check uses canonicalDestPath.startsWith(canonicalDirPath), which is inadequate because it does not require a path separator immediately after the destination directory prefix; for example, a destination /work/analysis-output is treated as containing /work/analysis-output2/evil, allowing extraction outside the intended directory."}]}
